mentions.name: Kiiro
mentions.description: Training analytics app for Apple Watch runners that tracks training load using a 42-day EWMA for chronic load and a 7-day EWMA for acute load, using HR-based calculations instead of rTSS. Provides zone breakdowns and route comparisons so runners can see whether their training is working, without anxiety-inducing made-up recovery scores. Free with no ads.
mentions.problem: Apple's Fitness app is too basic and third-party apps create anxiety with made-up recovery scores; Kiiro offers proper training load tracking without the daily judgment.
mentions.audience: Runners who train with an Apple Watch
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Kiiro — training analytics for Apple Watch runners.
